title: Winter Wine Weekend — Winter Wine Festival (Red Hill Showgrounds)
summary: Centrepiece of the Mornington Peninsula Winter Wine Weekend. Held at the Pavilions of Red Hill Showgrounds over the King's Birthday long weekend. Taste 35+ Mornington Peninsula wineries and 150+ wines in one place. Ticket includes Riedel tasting glass and all wine tastings. Masterclass upgrade avail
description: Centrepiece of the Mornington Peninsula Winter Wine Weekend. Held at the Pavilions of Red Hill Showgrounds over the King's Birthday long weekend. Taste 35+ Mornington Peninsula wineries and 150+ wines in one place. Ticket includes Riedel tasting glass and all wine tastings. Masterclass upgrade available ($105). Designated driver tickets $30. Wineries also host special events Sun–Mon across the Peninsula.
priceRange: AUD 90 General Admission; AUD 105 Masterclass; AUD 30 Designated Driver
suitableFor: Adults 18+ (children welcome under supervision); wine enthusiasts; tourists
accessibilityNotes: Pavilion accessible; children welcome; playground at Red Hill Reserve nearby
weatherDependency: Pavilion is indoor — Saturday weather largely irrelevant; surrounding winery events may be outdoor
nearbyAttractions: Red Hill Brewery Secret Stash (nearby weekend); Stonier Pies & Pinot; Paringa Estate
suggestedItineraryPairing: Book accommodation in Red Hill/Merricks; combine Sat festival with Sun/Mon cellar door lunches at Paringa or Ten Minutes by Tractor
internalNotes: Saturday 6 June = main festival at Red Hill Showgrounds 11am–4pm. Sunday 7 + Monday 8 June = cellar door events across the Peninsula. Separate ticketed events at individual wineries not individually listed.
